claims.text: NVDA management proved that all future revenue growth will be caused exclusively by generative AI and is guaranteed.

response.source_scope: Selected, versioned primary-source passages; absence is not proof of falsity.

results.reason: The claim asserts management proved all future revenue growth will be caused exclusively by generative AI and is guaranteed. The evidence mentions generative AI as a driver of Data Center and Compute growth and provides remaining performance obligation recognition expectations, but it does not state that all future revenue growth will be exclusively caused by generative AI, nor does it guarantee future growth.

facts.metric: expected recognition of remaining performance obligations over next twelve months

evidence.quote: Revenue allocated to remaining performance obligations, which includes deferred revenue and amounts that will be invoiced and recognized as revenue in future periods, was $1.1 billion as of January 28, 2024. We expect to recognize approximately 40% of this revenue over the next twelve months and the remainder thereafter.

Data Center revenue for fiscal year 2024 was $47.5 billion, up 217% from fiscal year 2023. In Data Center, we launched AI inference platforms that combine our full-stack inference software with NVIDIA Ada, NVIDIA Hopper and NVIDIA Grace Hopper processors optimized for generative AI, LLMs and other AI workloads.
Compute grew 266% due to higher shipments of the NVIDIA Hopper GPU computing platform for the training and inference of LLMs, recommendation engines and generative AI applications.

missing_fields: evidence that all future revenue growth is caused exclusively by generative AI
evidence that future revenue growth is guaranteed
results.claim: NVDA management proved that all future revenue growth will be caused exclusively by generative AI and is guaranteed.
